name: Synthesis of [Co(ttpp)(py)2](OTf)
plain_text_description:
Purposes
Obtain the precursor to MOCOF-1-(OH)2
References and modifications
AD-R27: Co(ttpp) AD-Rxx → ZAR-438
Co(+2) --> Co(+3) , Ag --> Ag(0) 
Analysis results
Yield: 71% (cf. AD-R27 96%)
1H NMR M1: too dilute, but mostly matching with AD-R27-M1
Reason behind chemical shift for pyridine: experiences ring current when located above porphyrinoid frameworks. It retains its own aromaticity, but it experiences significant magnetic shielding effects due to the macrocyclic ring current generated by the larger porphyrin system.
1H, 19F NMR P: matches AD-R27-P. Internal standard should be used next time.
ICP-OES: planned
Obtained products, insights, possible countermeasures
Slightly lower yield ← mistake in reprecipitation, loss in the filter paper

Procedure
RT 21.6 °C RH 40%
Stock solution preparation
5 mL vial
Put into the glovebox (H₂O < 1 ppm)
Weigh in AgOTf → 128.2 mg
Take it out of the glovebox
Add toluene 3000 µL [should be adjusted according to the AgOTf amount] → colorless solution
Reaction
50 mL flask
Add Co(ttpp)
Add pyridine
Add toluene 26 mL
Sonicate for 3 min → Dark red solution
Cover with aluminum foil
Start stirring at 400 rpm
Add 1500 µL of AgOTf/toluene dropwise with a mechanical pipette [syringe should be used]
Continue stirring for 2 h → Dark green mixture [1 h is enough]
→ small volume [should have been 100 µL] + 400 µL of CDCl₃ → ¹H NMR M1 (U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P: 6, SW: 19, NS: 16) [NS 16 is not necessary]
plain_text_observation:
Ag scavenging
Remove volatiles with rotovap (40 °C) 
Add 25 mL of DCM
Swirl and sonicate → Dark green mixture
Add ISOLUTE Si-Thiol
Stir at 500 rpm for 1 h
? mL RBF, suction adapter, glass funnel, filter paper (90 mm?, 15A?), diaphragm pump suction
Filter the mixture → Dark green filtrate
Rinse with DCM 50 mL → Pale green filtrate and xxx residue at the end

Reprecipitation
Add n-hexane (300 mL)
Refrigerate at 0 °C o/n
2026-06-17, RT 21.1°C, RH 50%
Filter the mixture → Light yellow filtrate
Rinse with DCM [mistake!]
Reprecipitation again: procedure?
Rinse with 2 x (DCM 15 mL + n-hexane 100 mL)
Rinse w/ n-hexane 4 x 20 mL
Dry w/ suction for 10 min
Dry under vacuum (diaphragm pump) for 5 h

Analysis
→ 1H NMR P (CDCl₃; U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P 6, SW 19, NS 16), [2,4-DCBTF internal standard should have been used]
2026-06-18
→ 19F NMR P (CDCl3, U1.834; N F19) [Parameters should have been adjusted. TD 262144, D1 10, SW 40, O1P −70; SI 262144] 
Not yet
→ ICP-OES (Co, Ag)
